phase: source-free synthetic DEVELOPMENT; no scientific first-use
citation: Hoover, Blayney, Whittington, Classical Energies Learn to Reason 1,000x Faster than Looped Models, arXiv:2611.17309 (2026-11-12)
independent_implementation: CRAM-inspired pairwise binary energy; NOT a CRAM reproduction
questions: Can pairwise energies learned from observed intervention consequences solve new length-12 and length-20 causal chains?
At matched accuracy do they beat a matched learned looped propagation baseline and exact signed-graph propagation on whole-process CPU cost?
task: Source-free binary intervention worlds: two edge relation types (identity/inversion), 512 independent parent->child intervention examples per type; new test trees with random topology, a randomized root intervention, a known edge-type label, 12 and 20 nodes; no observed nonroot test states
independent_training_and_test: Deterministic PRNG streams keyed by phase, seed, graph index; no example or label reuse across train/test.
arms: Learned signed pairwise energy; monotone single-bit coordinate descent; 8 seeded random restarts, <=64 sweeps; choose lowest-energy assignment
Learned recurrent wavefront update using the same fitted edge signs; <=64 synchronous rounds, stop on convergence
Exact signed-graph propagation using the same fitted edge signs and graph inputs; no access to test labels
Shuffled-sign energy negative control, identical search budget
costs: CPU wall process elapsed time via perf_counter_ns (fit + inference)
work units: pair-factor evaluations for energy, edge scans for looped and exact
primary_metric: fraction of test graphs with all node states correct, requiring 100% completion; also mean per-node accuracy
pass_rule: Energy is a scientific-development candidate only if it reaches >=99% exact graph accuracy for BOTH sizes and all five seeds, ties or beats recurrent on accuracy, and median whole-process wall time <=0.5x BOTH recurrent and exact, with no worse per-node accuracy. Otherwise DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO. No integration on either outcome.
negative_controls: Shuffle edge sign after fitting; target cannot be passed on unseen graphs at the same rate
Observe only a single root, no test nonroot truth permitted
No causal identification claims for empirical real-world data
No learned new relation family, only two known edge-class priors
analysis: All seeds and both sizes reported; no threshold/budget, hyperparameter, workload or seed retuning after test
control_note: Recurrent wavefront is a learned-weights iterative propagation proxy, not a retrained TRM/HRM; exact signed graph is the strongest specified control. Hence speed claims cannot be generalized to paper baselines.
